name: 3D Gaussian Splatting MVP
definition: A self-contained Jupyter notebook implementation of the core 3D Gaussian Splatting algorithm in pure PyTorch without custom CUDA kernels, intended as a teaching reference.
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting MVP is a pure-PyTorch teaching implementation that renders 3D Gaussians via readable Python loops, omitting CUDA and optimization features found in production variants.
